ARMS_DESIGN.arms: meta.arm 'composites' (A, the incumbent) against 'gen' (B, the branch), within ONE pipeline_version
ARMS_DESIGN.decides: better / worse only when (1) at least MIN_SHARED_DAYS whole ET days carry a stratum both arms scored in, (2) the test is significant at alpha, and (3) every CELL with an event in such a stratum points strictly the same way, a cell's direction being the sign of the sum over its shared strata of k_b - K n_b / (n_a + n_b); otherwise indistinguishable, or withheld under (1). Events in a stratum only one arm scored in are outside the test and are counted, never deciding
ARMS_DESIGN.estimand: alphas clearing EVERY binding check per 1,000 scored alphas
ARMS_DESIGN.mdr: the smallest ratio B/A that this decision -- test, direction rule and day minimum together -- reaches with power_for_mdr, on these strata's exposures at arm A's own rate per cell (not the pooled rate, round 3 m3)
ARMS_DESIGN.stratum: (ET quota day, cell): a whole ET day before the one `now` and `data_through` fall in, and cell = <region>/d<delay> (D28)
ARMS_DESIGN.test: exact conditional test stratified by (day, cell): given each stratum's K = k_a + k_b, k_b ~ Binomial(K, n_b / (n_a + n_b)) under H0; T = sum of k_b over the strata both arms scored in, its null law the exact convolution of those binomials; two-sided p = min(1, 2 x the smaller tail) (stratified_rate_test_p). Conditioning on each day's total is what makes between-day variation cancel

constants.COMPARE_IS_NOT_GATE3: NOT RULE 2 gate-3 evidence (round 3 F1; D47 superseded D33). Two versions run one after the other, so every ET day belongs to one arm and the between-day variation of the estimand lands in the comparison: within USA/d1 the dispersion across days was 11.34 on both the Mac and the host journal copies (95 % interval [5.4, 37.8]), and under NO version effect this read-out said better or worse in 0.49-0.56 of placebo draws (day-block bootstrap of the 9 real days: 0.488 at 7 days per arm, 0.501 at 14, 0.486 at 28), more days not reducing it. MECHANISM of the day-level variation: UNKNOWN. A branch is proven by compare_arms() on rounds randomised within each ET day.

ESTIMAND.decides: better / worse only when the stratified test is significant at `alpha` AND every cell with at least one event was scored by both arms and points strictly the same way; otherwise indistinguishable. The pooled test is printed and never decides (D28)
ESTIMAND.denominator: distinct alpha ids scored (status COMPLETE or WARNING, with a check set), created on a whole ET quota day before the day `now` falls in and before the day `data_through` falls in
ESTIMAND.interval: exact Poisson (Garwood) 95 % on the count, exposure = scored alphas / 1,000
ESTIMAND.name: alphas clearing EVERY binding check per 1,000 scored alphas
ESTIMAND.not_the_submission_count: this is NOT the submission count: a submission also needs the correlation lines, the submitter and the 4-per-day cap, none of which this estimand sees
ESTIMAND.numerator: distinct alpha ids whose check set reads PASS for every name in binding_checks
ESTIMAND.test: exact conditional test of two Poisson rates STRATIFIED BY CELL (D28): given each cell's K_c = k_ac + k_bc, k_bc ~ Binomial(K_c, n_bc / (n_ac + n_bc)) under H0; the statistic is the sum of k_bc over the cells both arms scored in, its null distribution the exact convolution of those binomials; two-sided p = min(1, 2 x the smaller tail)
